audit.basis: Supplied PDF bookmarks; historical City HTML agenda not independently audited

items.title: Ratification of Warrants
items.recommendation: Ratify Warrants dated: February 10, 2022, and February 17, 2022.

items.title: Re-Ratification of Local Emergency and Re-Authorizing the Use of Teleconferencing to Conduct Public Meetings
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Proclaiming a Local Emergency Persists, Re-Ratifying the Proclamation of a State of Emergency by Executive Order N-09-21, and Re- Authorizing Remote Teleconference Meetings of the Legislative Bodies of the City of Beaumont for the Period of March 1, 2022, through April 5, 2022, Pursuant to Provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act.”

items.title: Request for City Council to Accept the Street and Sewer Improvements Associated with Parcel Map No. 34209 into the Publicly Maintained System and Exonerate Maintenance Bond No. 107174931
items.recommendation: Accept the Street Improvements associated with Parcel Map No. 34209, Authorize the Mayor to Sign the Certificate of Acceptance, and Authorize City staff to issue a Bond Exoneration Letter for Maintenance Bond No. 107174931.

items.title: Second Reading to Approve an Addition to Municipal Code Section 1.16 “General Penalty” Adding Penalties for the Possession and Use of Illegal Fireworks
items.recommendation: Waive the second full reading and adopt by title only, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, Amending the Beaumont Municipal Code to Amend Chapter 1.16 Entitled ‘General Penalty’ and Making Findings Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act”

items.title: Public Hearing and Consideration of a Resolution Establishing a Solid Waste SB 1383 Organics Waiver Application Fee
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing, and Waive the full reading and approve by title only, “Resolution Establishing an Organics Waste Service Waiver Application Fee for Commercial Premises in Accordance with City of Beaumont Municipal Code Section 8.12.180.”

items.title: Public Hearing and First Reading of An Ordinance to Adopt an Amendment to the Four Seasons Specific Plan (SP2022-0007)
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing, and Waive the first full reading and approve by title only, “An Ordinance of the City Council of Beaumont, California, Adopting an Amendment to the Four Seasons Specific Plan (SP2022-0007).”

items.title: Public Hearing to Adopt California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Initial Study/Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation and Monitoring Reporting Program for the West Side Fire Station Located on the East Side of Potrero Boulevard, North of SR 60 Freeway and South of San Timoteo Canyon Road
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing, Adopt a Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation and Monitoring Reporting Program for the West Side Fire Station project, and Direct staff to prepare a Notice of Determination to be filed with the Riverside County Clerk Recorder.

items.title: Approval of Compensation Plan and Salary Table
items.recommendation: Approval of the Compensation Plan and Salary Table.

items.title: Rangel Park Update
items.recommendation: Receive and provide direction to City staff.

items.title: Request to Authorize Grant Writing Assistance to Townsend Public Affairs, Inc. in the Amount of $15,000
items.recommendation: Approve a one-time request for grant writing assistance with Townsend Public Affairs, Inc. in the amount of $15,000 and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement.

items.title: Award a Professional Services Agreement to Dudek, Inc., for Groundwater and Surface Water Monitoring Services Related to the Maximum Benefit Monitoring Program
items.recommendation: Award a Professional Services Agreement to Dudek, Inc., for groundwater and surface water monitoring services for three years in the amount not to exceed $52,330 in year one, $53,900 in year two, and $55,500 in year three.

items.title: Set Time, Date and Place for Special Workshop
items.recommendation: Establish a time, date and place for a special workshop.

items.title: Assign and Approve a Designated City Council Member to Participate in the Review and Recommendation of Proposals for Landscape Architecture and Engineering Design Services for the Stewart Park Improvement Project
items.recommendation: Assign and approve a designated City Council Member to participate in the review and recommendation of proposals for landscape architecture and engineering design services for the Stewart Park Improvement Project.

items.title: Consider a Resolution to Oppose Initiative 21-0042A1
items.recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider this resolution and take action as it deems appropriate.

items.title: Discussion of Assembly Bill 571 and Campaign Contribution Limits
items.recommendation: Discussion and direction to City staff.

items.title: Economic Development Committee Vacancy of Community Member Seat
items.recommendation: Direct City staff to notice the partial-term vacancy on the Economic Development Committee for the “Non-Business Community Member” and “Alternate” seats.
